title: SplatBundleLayout
description: GET .../bundle of a 'splat' job: the splat-prepare bundle.zip, rebuilt entry by entry by the server (RunnerBundle): images metadata-stripped and stored, at most 20000 entries, 8 GiB uncompressed, 256 MiB per entry. Directory entries (ending in /) are ignored. Paths with .., a leading /, \ or :, or over 300 characters are refused. The instance is the list of the zip's entry names, in order.
